# Step 2: Assembly

Assembly of the BBD nanopore reads with Flye. Commands for this step were run in `flye/`.
Change directory to flye
```{bash}
cd ~/bbd-metagenome/flye
pwd
ln -s /pvol/data/metagenome_assembly/bbd_0.1.fastq.gz .


```

Slurm script 
```{bash}
sbatch run_flye_bbd.sh #job 514
squeue # check position in que
tail -f slurm-514.out #track 
```

Check flye output
```{bash}
sacct -j 514 --format=JobID,State,MaxRSS,Elapsed

ls -l bbd/assembly.fasta # finished assembly fasta.
```
